title: [Generation Goal]
content:
[Generation Goal]
Generate a 30-second cinematic lifestyle film for Van Cleef & Arpels fine jewelry. The central subject is a 20-year-old East Asian woman living a golden-hour day in a warm coastal town. The primary event is her wearing and interacting with a Van Cleef & Arpels Alhambra-style carnelian and rose-gold jewelry collection — a pendant necklace that opens to reveal a hidden watch, a two-row layered necklace, drop earrings, two bracelets (one also concealing a watch face), and a ring — with one scene built around her personally opening the pendant's secret watch.

[Reference Materials]
@ Image 1 defines fit/scale only — how a necklace sits against a neckline and collarbone. Do not use this person's face, body, or identity.
@ Image 2 defines the single drop earring's structure, metal color, and clover charm design.
@ Image 3 defines the paired drop earrings' structure and how they hang and move.
@ Image 4 defines the two-row layered necklace — alternating rose-gold and carnelian clovers, chain spacing, and drape.
@ Image 5 defines fit/scale only — how the pendant sits near the collarbone. Do not use this person's face, body, or identity.
@ Image 6 defines the dangle chain bracelet's structure — chain with carnelian clover charms.
@ Image 7 defines the round bracelet's structure — full circle of alternating rose-gold and carnelian clovers.
@ Image 8 defines fit/scale only — how the pendant is held and rests against the body. Do not use this person's face, body, or identity.
@ Image 9 defines the pendant necklace's chain length, clasp, and how the pendant hangs.
@ Image 10 defines the carnelian clover cover's exact shape, bezel detail, and color, isolated from the chain.
@ Image 11 defines the ring's structure and metal/stone finish. [Please confirm this is the ring — the thumbnail was cropped in your screenshot.]
@ Video 1 defines the motion only: fingers lifting the hinged carnelian clover cover open to reveal the mother-of-pearl watch face beneath, with the cover's pivot point at the top edge. Do not use the person, clothing, or background from this video.

[Subject Profile: The Woman]
20-year-old East Asian woman, diamond-shaped face, petite build, sharp jawline, warm natural smile, dark hair, natural makeup, styled glamorously like a campaign model but moving and reacting naturally rather than posed. Her face, hairstyle, proportions, and outfit stay identical across every stage. She wears all pieces simultaneously and consistently once introduced: the pendant necklace over the two-row necklace, drop earrings, the round bracelet on one wrist, the dangle bracelet on the other, and the ring — nothing is added or removed mid-film except the pendant's cover, which opens once in Stage 3 and stays open for the rest of the film.

[Stage 1 — 0-3s: Street Walk]
@ Imagewo-row layered necklace (@ Image 4), fit reference @  Image 1.
Initial state: warm, terracotta-toned coastal street, low golden sunlight.
Primary event: she walks toward camera in flowing warm-toned resort wear; the two-row necklace catches light at her collarbone with each step.
End state: close, windblown framing settling on her face and neckline.

[Stage 2 — 3-6s: Pendant Close-Up]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), fit reference @ Image 8.
Primary event: camera tilts down from her smiling face to the closed carnelian pendant resting over the two-row necklace; her fingers lightly lift the pendant to inspect it.
End state: pendant centered and sharp in shallow focus, still closed.

[Stage 3 — 6-9s: The Reveal]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), reveal motion (@ Video 1).
Primary event: macro shot as she gently opens the hinged carnelian clover cover with two fingers, revealing the mother-of-pearl watch dial and gold hands beneath, exactly matching the opening motion and pivot point from @ Video 1.
End state: pendant now open, watch face fully visible and lit, cover resting upright against the chain.

[Stage 4 — 9-12s: Warm Courtyard Walk]
Use: round bracelet (@ Image 7).
Primary event: low-angle tracking shot along sunlit terracotta paving as she walks; the round bracelet catches light on her wrist with each stride.
End state: bracelet sharp and lit in the foreground, her figure continuing out of frame.

[Stage 5 — 12-15s: Terrace Profile]
Use: drop earrings (@ Image 2, @ Image 3).
Primary event: she stands in profile on a warm rooftop terrace at golden hour, wind moving her hair; the drop earrings swing gently and catch the light.
End state: clean profile silhouette against warm sky, earrings mid-swing and lit.

[Stage 6 — 15-18s: Café]
Use: dangle bracelet (@ Image 6), ring (@ Image 11).
Primary event: seated at a sunlit window table, she lifts a drink toward her lips; the dangle bracelet and ring both catch warm light as her hand moves.
End state: bracelet and ring sharp in the foreground, café interior soft behind her.

[Stage 7 — 18-21s: Warm Water]
Use: pendant necklace (open, from Stage 3), two-row necklace (@ Image 4).
Primary event: water-level shot in warm, amber-lit shallows as she floats and laughs; droplets catch light on the open pendant and layered necklace.
End state: she settles mid-laugh, both necklaces glinting through the water droplets.

[Stage 8 — 21-24s: Night Market]
Use: drop earrings, round bracelet.
Primary event: handheld walk through a lantern-lit market; she reaches for a treat, wrist and earrings both catching warm lantern and neon light.
End state: her hand mid-reach, jewelry glowing warmly against blurred market bokeh.

[Stage 9 — 24-27s: Sunset Silhouette]
Use: pendant necklace (open), two-row necklace.
Primary event: wide shot facing an orange-red sunset, hair and dress moving in the wind.
End state: full silhouette against the sunset, a warm rim-light outlining both necklace chains.

[Stage 10 — 27-29s: Balcony Close]
Use: pendant necklace (open, watch face visible).
Primary event: on a warm-lit balcony at dusk, she turns into an intimate close-up, softly smiling, glancing briefly down at the open watch face.
End state: her face and the open pendant both in sharp, warm-lit focus.

[Stage 11 — 29-30s: End Plate]
Primary event: gentle push-out and defocus as she exits frame, leaving a clean, evenly lit, warm terracotta-toned empty background with soft bokeh.
End state: uncluttered negative space, ready for the Van Cleef & Arpels logo to be composited in post. [If you're supplying a logo reference image, bind it here as its own image with "use only for wordmark style and color, do not distort" — but treat post-production compositing as the reliable fallback, since exact logotype letterforms aren't guaranteed from a text/image prompt alone.]

[Style]
Warm amber, rust, and rose-gold color grade throughout — even the water and market scenes lean warm rather than cool/turquoise, so nothing fights the carnelian stones. Soft golden-hour and warm lantern lighting, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field on jewelry close-ups, subtle 35mm film grain, gentle natural motion blur on movement. Documentary-realistic handheld performance on the travel beats, smoother controlled camera work on the jewelry close-ups (Stages 2, 3, 6, 10).

[Maintain Consistency]
Keep her facial identity, proportions, hairstyle, makeup, and every jewelry piece identical and in the same position across stages. Once opened in Stage 3, the pendant stays open for all subsequent stages. Preserve natural autofocus behavior and film grain throughout.

Avoid: CGI look, plastic skin, identity drift, distorted anatomy, duplicate people, oversaturation, blurry face, warped or melted clover/watch geometry, incorrect hinge direction on the pendant, and any generated logo text outside the designated end plate.

es.content:
---
[Objetivo de generación]
Genera una película lifestyle cinematográfica de 30 segundos para joyería fina de Van Cleef & Arpels. El sujeto central es una mujer de Asia oriental de 20 años que vive un día de golden hour en una cálida ciudad costera. El evento principal es que lleva e interactúa con una colección de joyas Van Cleef & Arpels estilo Alhambra en cornalina y oro rosa — un collar colgante que se abre para revelar un reloj oculto, un collar de dos filas en capas, pendientes colgantes, dos pulseras (una de ellas también oculta una esfera de reloj) y un anillo — con una escena construida alrededor de cómo abre personalmente el reloj secreto del colgante.

[Materiales de referencia]
@ Image 1 define solo el ajuste/escala — cómo un collar se asienta sobre el escote y la clavícula. No uses el rostro, el cuerpo ni la identidad de esta persona.
@ Image 2 define la estructura del pendiente colgante individual, el color del metal y el diseño del charm de trébol.
@ Image 3 define la estructura de los pendientes colgantes en pareja y cómo cuelgan y se mueven.
@ Image 4 define el collar de dos filas en capas — tréboles alternados de oro rosa y cornalina, separación de la cadena y caída.
@ Image 5 define solo el ajuste/escala — cómo el colgante se sitúa cerca de la clavícula. No uses el rostro, el cuerpo ni la identidad de esta persona.
@ Image 6 define la estructura de la pulsera con cadena colgante — cadena con charms de trébol de cornalina.
@ Image 7 define la estructura de la pulsera redonda — círculo completo de tréboles alternados de oro rosa y cornalina.
@ Image 8 define solo el ajuste/escala — cómo el colgante se sostiene y descansa contra el cuerpo. No uses el rostro, el cuerpo ni la identidad de esta persona.
@ Image 9 define la longitud de la cadena del collar colgante, el cierre y cómo cuelga el colgante.
@ Image 10 define la forma exacta de la cubierta de trébol de cornalina, el detalle del bisel y el color, aislado de la cadena.
@ Image 11 define la estructura del anillo y el acabado del metal/piedra. [Por favor confirma que este es el anillo — la miniatura estaba recortada en tu captura.]
@ Video 1 define solo el movimiento: dedos levantando la cubierta articulada de trébol de cornalina para revelar la esfera del reloj de nácar debajo, con el punto de pivote de la cubierta en el borde superior. No uses la persona, la ropa ni el fondo de este video.

[Perfil del sujeto: la mujer]
Mujer de Asia oriental de 20 años, rostro en forma de diamante, complexión pequeña, mandíbula marcada, sonrisa natural y cálida, cabello oscuro, maquillaje natural, estilizada con glamour como una modelo de campaña pero moviéndose y reaccionando de forma natural en lugar de posada. Su rostro, peinado, proporciones y vestuario se mantienen idénticos en todas las etapas. Lleva todas las piezas simultáneamente y de forma consistente una vez introducidas: el collar colgante sobre el collar de dos filas, los pendientes colgantes, la pulsera redonda en una muñeca, la pulsera con cadena colgante en la otra y el anillo — no se añade ni se quita nada a mitad del film, excepto la cubierta del colgante, que se abre una vez en la Etapa 3 y permanece abierta durante el resto del film.

[Etapa 1 — 0-3s: Paseo por la calle]
@ Imagewo-row layered necklace (@ Image 4), fit reference @  Image 1.
Estado inicial: calle costera cálida, en tonos terracota, con luz dorada baja.
Evento principal: camina hacia la cámara con ropa resort fluida en tonos cálidos; el collar de dos filas capta la luz en la clavícula con cada paso.
Estado final: encuadre cercano, con viento, que se asienta sobre su rostro y escote.

[Etapa 2 — 3-6s: Primer plano del colgante]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), fit reference @ Image 8.
Evento principal: la cámara inclina hacia abajo desde su rostro sonriente hasta el colgante de cornalina cerrado que descansa sobre el collar de dos filas; sus dedos levantan suavemente el colgante para निरीccionarlo.
Estado final: colgante centrado y nítido en poca profundidad de campo, aún cerrado.

[Etapa 3 — 6-9s: La revelación]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), reveal motion (@ Video 1).
Evento principal: plano macro mientras abre con delicadeza la cubierta articulada de trébol de cornalina con dos dedos, revelando la esfera del reloj de nácar y las agujas doradas debajo, exactamente igual al movimiento de apertura y al punto de pivote de @ Video 1.
Estado final: colgante ahora abierto, esfera del reloj totalmente visible e iluminada, con la cubierta apoyada en vertical contra la cadena.

[Etapa 4 — 9-12s: Paseo por el patio cálido]
Use: round bracelet (@ Image 7).
Evento principal: plano de seguimiento a baja altura sobre un pavimento de terracota iluminado por el sol mientras camina; la pulsera redonda capta la luz en su muñeca con cada zancada.
Estado final: pulsera nítida e iluminada en primer plano, su figura continuando fuera de cuadro.

[Etapa 5 — 12-15s: Perfil en la terraza]
Use: drop earrings (@ Image 2, @ Image 3).
Evento principal: está de perfil en una terraza cálida en la azotea durante la golden hour, con el viento moviendo su cabello; los pendientes colgantes se balancean suavemente y captan la luz.
Estado final: silueta de perfil limpia contra el cielo cálido, pendientes en pleno balanceo e iluminados.

[Etapa 6 — 15-18s: Café]
Use: dangle bracelet (@ Image 6), ring (@ Image 11).
Evento principal: sentada junto a una mesa de ventana iluminada por el sol, levanta una bebida hacia los labios; la pulsera con cadena colgante y el anillo captan la luz cálida mientras mueve la mano.
Estado final: pulsera y anillo nítidos en primer plano, interior del café suave detrás de ella.

[Etapa 7 — 18-21s: Agua cálida]
Use: pendant necklace (open, from Stage 3), two-row necklace (@ Image 4).
Evento principal: plano a nivel del agua en aguas poco profundas iluminadas en tonos ámbar mientras flota y ríe; las gotas captan la luz sobre el colgante abierto y el collar en capas.
Estado final: se queda en medio de la risa, ambos collares brillando a través de las gotas de agua.

[Etapa 8 — 21-24s: Mercado nocturno]
Use: drop earrings, round bracelet.
Evento principal: paseo en cámara en mano por un mercado iluminado con faroles; alcanza un bocado, y tanto la muñeca como los pendientes captan la luz cálida de los faroles y el neón.
Estado final: su mano a medio alcance, la joyería brillando cálidamente contra el bokeh desenfocado del mercado.

[Etapa 9 — 24-27s: Silueta al atardecer]
Use: pendant necklace (open), two-row necklace.
Evento principal: plano general frente a un atardecer naranja rojizo, con el cabello y el vestido moviéndose con el viento.
Estado final: silueta completa contra el atardecer, con una cálida luz de contorno delineando ambas cadenas del collar.

[Etapa 10 — 27-29s: Primer plano en el balcón]
Use: pendant necklace (open, watch face visible).
Evento principal: en un balcón iluminado con calidez al anochecer, gira hacia un primer plano íntimo, sonríe suavemente y mira brevemente hacia abajo la esfera abierta del reloj.
Estado final: su rostro y el colgante abierto ambos en foco nítido y con luz cálida.

[Etapa 11 — 29-30s: Placa final]
Evento principal: suave alejamiento y desenfoque mientras sale del encuadre, dejando un fondo limpio, uniformemente iluminado, vacío y en tonos terracota cálidos, con bokeh suave.
Estado final: espacio negativo despejado, listo para que el logotipo de Van Cleef & Arpels se componga en posproducción. [Si vas a proporcionar una imagen de referencia del logotipo, vincúlala aquí como su propia imagen con "use only for wordmark style and color, do not distort" — pero trata la composición en posproducción como la opción de respaldo fiable, ya que las formas exactas de las letras del logotipo no están garantizadas solo con un prompt de texto/imagen.]

[Estilo]
Paleta de color cálida

fr.content:
---
[Objectif de génération]
Générez un film lifestyle cinématographique de 30 secondes pour la haute joaillerie Van Cleef & Arpels. Le sujet central est une femme est-asiatique de 20 ans vivant une journée à l’heure dorée dans une ville côtière chaleureuse. L’événement principal est qu’elle porte et interagit avec une collection de bijoux Van Cleef & Arpels style Alhambra en cornaline et or rose — un collier pendentif qui s’ouvre pour révéler une montre cachée, un collier à deux rangs superposés, des boucles d’oreilles pendantes, deux bracelets (dont l’un dissimule également un cadran de montre) et une bague — avec une scène construite autour du moment où elle ouvre elle-même la montre secrète du pendentif.

[Matériaux de référence]
@ Image 1 définit uniquement l’ajustement/la proportion — la façon dont un collier se place sur un décolleté et la clavicule. N’utilisez pas le visage, le corps ni l’identité de cette personne.
@ Image 2 définit la structure de la boucle d’oreille pendante unique, la couleur du métal et le design du charm en forme de trèfle.
@ Image 3 définit la structure des boucles d’oreilles pendantes jumelles et la façon dont elles tombent et bougent.
@ Image 4 définit le collier à deux rangs superposés — alternance de trèfles en or rose et en cornaline, espacement de la chaîne et tombé.
@ Image 5 définit uniquement l’ajustement/la proportion — la façon dont le pendentif se place près de la clavicule. N’utilisez pas le visage, le corps ni l’identité de cette personne.
@ Image 6 définit la structure du bracelet à chaîne pendante — chaîne avec charms trèfle en cornaline.
@ Image 7 définit la structure du bracelet rond — cercle complet de trèfles alternés en or rose et en cornaline.
@ Image 8 définit uniquement l’ajustement/la proportion — la façon dont le pendentif est tenu et repose contre le corps. N’utilisez pas le visage, le corps ni l’identité de cette personne.
@ Image 9 définit la longueur de chaîne du collier pendentif, le fermoir et la façon dont le pendentif tombe.
@ Image 10 définit la forme exacte du couvercle trèfle en cornaline, le détail du serti et la couleur, isolés de la chaîne.
@ Image 11 définit la structure de la bague et la finition métal/pierre. [Veuillez confirmer qu’il s’agit bien de la bague — la miniature a été recadrée dans votre capture d’écran.]
@ Video 1 définit uniquement le mouvement : des doigts soulèvent le couvercle articulé en cornaline en forme de trèfle pour révéler le cadran de montre en nacre en dessous, avec le point de pivot du couvercle situé sur le bord supérieur. N’utilisez pas la personne, les vêtements ni l’arrière-plan de cette vidéo.

[Profil du sujet : la femme]
Femme est-asiatique de 20 ans, visage en forme de losange, petite silhouette, mâchoire marquée, sourire naturel et chaleureux, cheveux foncés, maquillage naturel, stylisée de manière glamour comme une modèle de campagne mais se déplaçant et réagissant naturellement plutôt que de façon posée. Son visage, sa coiffure, ses proportions et sa tenue restent identiques à chaque étape. Elle porte toutes les pièces simultanément et de manière cohérente une fois introduites : le collier pendentif par-dessus le collier à deux rangs, les boucles d’oreilles pendantes, le bracelet rond à un poignet, le bracelet à chaîne pendante à l’autre, et la bague — rien n’est ajouté ni retiré en cours de film, sauf le couvercle du pendentif, qui s’ouvre une fois à l’étape 3 et reste ouvert pour le reste du film.

[Étape 1 — 0-3 s : Marche dans la rue]
@ Imagewo-row layered necklace (@ Image 4), fit reference @  Image 1.
État initial : rue côtière chaude aux tons terre cuite, lumière dorée basse.
Événement principal : elle marche vers la caméra dans une tenue de resort fluide aux tons chauds ; le collier à deux rangs capte la lumière au niveau de la clavicule à chaque pas.
État final : cadrage rapproché, balayé par le vent, se posant sur son visage et son décolleté.

[Étape 2 — 3-6 s : Gros plan sur le pendentif]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), fit reference @ Image 8.
Événement principal : la caméra s’incline vers le bas depuis son visage souriant jusqu’au pendentif en cornaline fermé reposant sur le collier à deux rangs ; ses doigts soulèvent légèrement le pendentif pour l’examiner.
État final : pendentif centré et net en faible profondeur de champ, toujours fermé.

[Étape 3 — 6-9 s : La révélation]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), reveal motion (@ Video 1).
Événement principal : plan macro alors qu’elle ouvre doucement le couvercle articulé en cornaline en forme de trèfle avec deux doigts, révélant le cadran de montre en nacre et les aiguilles dorées en dessous, en reproduisant exactement le mouvement d’ouverture et le point de pivot de @ Video 1.
État final : pendentif désormais ouvert, cadran de montre entièrement visible et éclairé, couvercle reposant verticalement contre la chaîne.

[Étape 4 — 9-12 s : Marche dans la cour chaude]
Use: round bracelet (@ Image 7).
Événement principal : travelling en contre-plongée le long d’un pavage en terre cuite baigné de soleil pendant qu’elle marche ; le bracelet rond capte la lumière à son poignet à chaque pas.
État final : bracelet net et éclairé au premier plan, sa silhouette continuant hors champ.

[Étape 5 — 12-15 s : Profil sur la terrasse]
Use: drop earrings (@ Image 2, @ Image 3).
Événement principal : elle se tient de profil sur une terrasse de toit chaleureuse à l’heure dorée, le vent anime ses cheveux ; les boucles d’oreilles pendantes oscillent doucement et captent la lumière.
État final : silhouette de profil nette sur fond de ciel chaud, boucles d’oreilles en plein mouvement et éclairées.

[Étape 6 — 15-18 s : Café]
Use: dangle bracelet (@ Image 6), ring (@ Image 11).
Événement principal : assise à une table près d’une fenêtre baignée de soleil, elle lève une boisson vers ses lèvres ; le bracelet à chaîne pendante et la bague captent tous deux la lumière chaude lorsque sa main bouge.
État final : bracelet et bague nets au premier plan, intérieur du café adouci derrière elle.

[Étape 7 — 18-21 s : Eau chaude]
Use: pendant necklace (open, from Stage 3), two-row necklace (@ Image 4).
Événement principal : plan au ras de l’eau dans des eaux peu profondes baignées d’une lumière ambrée chaude, alors qu’elle flotte et rit ; les gouttelettes accrochent la lumière sur le pendentif ouvert et le collier superposé.
État final : elle se calme au milieu d’un rire, les deux colliers scintillant à travers les gouttelettes d’eau.

[Étape 8 — 21-24 s : Marché de nuit]
Use: drop earrings, round bracelet.
Événement principal : marche caméra à la main dans un marché éclairé par des lanternes ; elle tend la main vers une gourmandise, son poignet et ses boucles d’oreilles captant à la fois la lumière chaude des lanternes et les néons.
État final : sa main en plein geste, bijoux rayonnant chaleureusement sur un bokeh de marché flou.

[Étape 9 — 24-27 s : Silhouette au coucher du soleil]
Use: pendant necklace (open), two-row necklace.
Événement principal : plan large face à un coucher de soleil orange-rouge, cheveux et robe animés par le vent.
État final : silhouette complète sur fond de coucher de soleil, un liseré lumineux chaud soulignant les deux chaînes du collier.

[Étape 10 — 27-29 s : Gros plan sur le balcon]
Use: pendant necklace (open, watch face visible).
Événement principal : sur un balcon éclairé de façon chaleureuse au crépuscule, elle se tourne vers un gros plan intime, sourit doucement, jetant un bref regard vers le bas sur le cadran de montre ouvert.
État final : son visage et le pendentif ouvert tous deux nets, dans une lumière chaude.

[Étape 11 — 29-30 s : End Plate]
Événement principal : léger recul de caméra et défocalisation alors qu’elle sort du cadre, laissant un fond vide propre, uniformément éclairé, aux tons terre cuite chauds, avec un bokeh doux

ja.content:
---
[生成目標]
Van Cleef & Arpels のファインジュエリーを主役にした、30秒のシネマティックなライフスタイルフィルムを生成する。中心となる被写体は、温暖な海辺の町でゴールデンアワーの一日を過ごす20歳の東アジア系女性。主な演出は、Van Cleef & Arpels のアルハンブラ風カーネリアン＆ローズゴールドのジュエリーコレクションを身につけ、触れ合う彼女の姿である。コレクションには、隠し時計が現れるペンダントネックレス、2連レイヤードネックレス、ドロップイヤリング、2本のブレスレット（うち1本は時計の文字盤を隠している）、そしてリングが含まれる。さらに、彼女自身がペンダントの秘密の時計を開くシーンを1つ組み込む。

[参考素材]
@ Image 1 はフィット感／スケールのみを定義する — ネックレスが首元と鎖骨にどう乗るか。人物の顔、体、アイデンティティは使用しないこと。
@ Image 2 はシングルのドロップイヤリングの構造、金属色、クローバーチャームのデザインを定義する。
@ Image 3 はペアのドロップイヤリングの構造と、どのように揺れ動くかを定義する。
@ Image 4 は2連レイヤードネックレス — ローズゴールドとカーネリアンのクローバーが交互に並ぶ構成、チェーンの間隔、ドレープ感 — を定義する。
@ Image 5 はフィット感／スケールのみを定義する — ペンダントが鎖骨の近くにどう収まるか。人物の顔、体、アイデンティティは使用しないこと。
@ Image 6 はダングルチェーンブレスレットの構造 — カーネリアンのクローバーチャームが付いたチェーン — を定義する。
@ Image 7 はラウンドブレスレットの構造 — ローズゴールドとカーネリアンのクローバーが交互に並ぶ完全な円形 — を定義する。
@ Image 8 はフィット感／スケールのみを定義する — ペンダントがどのように持たれ、体に寄り添って休むか。人物の顔、体、アイデンティティは使用しないこと。
@ Image 9 はペンダントネックレスのチェーンの長さ、留め具、そしてペンダントの垂れ下がり方を定義する。
@ Image 10 はカーネリアンのクローバーカバーの正確な形状、ベゼルのディテール、色を、チェーンから切り離した状態で定義する。
@ Image 11 はリングの構造と金属／石の仕上げを定義する。[スクリーンショットではサムネイルが切れていたため、これがリングであることを確認してください。]
@ Video 1 は動きのみを定義する：指がヒンジ付きのカーネリアンのクローバーカバーを持ち上げて開き、その下のマザーオブパールの時計文字盤を見せる動き。カバーの支点は上端にある。この動画の人物、衣装、背景は使用しないこと。

[被写体プロフィール：女性]
20歳の東アジア系女性。ダイヤ型の顔、小柄な体型、シャープな顎のライン、温かみのある自然な笑顔、ダークヘア、ナチュラルメイク。キャンペーンモデルのように華やかにスタイリングされているが、ポーズを取るのではなく自然に動き、反応する。顔立ち、髪型、体型、衣装は全ステージを通して同一に保つ。導入後はすべてのジュエリーを同時に一貫して着用する：2連ネックレスの上にペンダントネックレス、ドロップイヤリング、片方の手首にラウンドブレスレット、もう片方の手首にダングルブレスレット、そしてリング。フィルム中に追加・削除されるものは何もない。ただし、ペンダントのカバーだけはStage 3で一度開き、その後は最後まで開いたままにする。

[Stage 1 — 0-3s: Street Walk]
@ Imagewo-row layered necklace (@ Image 4), fit reference @  Image 1.
Initial state: warm, terracotta-toned coastal street, low golden sunlight.
Primary event: she walks toward camera in flowing warm-toned resort wear; the two-row necklace catches light at her collarbone with each step.
End state: close, windblown framing settling on her face and neckline.

[Stage 2 — 3-6s: Pendant Close-Up]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), fit reference @ Image 8.
Primary event: camera tilts down from her smiling face to the closed carnelian pendant resting over the two-row necklace; her fingers lightly lift the pendant to inspect it.
End state: pendant centered and sharp in shallow focus, still closed.

[Stage 3 — 6-9s: The Reveal]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), reveal motion (@ Video 1).
Primary event: macro shot as she gently opens the hinged carnelian clover cover with two fingers, revealing the mother-of-pearl watch dial and gold hands beneath, exactly matching the opening motion and pivot point from @ Video 1.
End state: pendant now open, watch face fully visible and lit, cover resting upright against the chain.

[Stage 4 — 9-12s: Warm Courtyard Walk]
Use: round bracelet (@ Image 7).
Primary event: low-angle tracking shot along sunlit terracotta paving as she walks; the round bracelet catches light on her wrist with each stride.
End state: bracelet sharp and lit in the foreground, her figure continuing out of frame.

[Stage 5 — 12-15s: Terrace Profile]
Use: drop earrings (@ Image 2, @ Image 3).
Primary event: she stands in profile on a warm rooftop terrace at golden hour, wind moving her hair; the drop earrings swing gently and catch the light.
End state: clean profile silhouette against warm sky, earrings mid-swing and lit.

[Stage 6 — 15-18s: Café]
Use: dangle bracelet (@ Image 6), ring (@ Image 11).
Primary event: seated at a sunlit window table, she lifts a drink toward her lips; the dangle bracelet and ring both catch warm light as her hand moves.
End state: bracelet and ring sharp in the foreground, café interior soft behind her.

[Stage 7 — 18-21s: Warm Water]
Use: pendant necklace (open, from Stage 3), two-row necklace (@ Image 4).
Primary event: water-level shot in warm, amber-lit shallows as she floats and laughs; droplets catch light on the open pendant and layered necklace.
End state: she settles mid-laugh, both necklaces glinting through the water droplets.

[Stage 8 — 21-24s: Night Market]
Use: drop earrings, round bracelet.
Primary event: handheld walk through a lantern-lit market; she reaches for a treat, wrist and earrings both catching warm lantern and neon light.
End state: her hand mid-reach, jewelry glowing warmly against blurred market bokeh.

[Stage 9 — 24-27s: Sunset Silhouette]
Use: pendant necklace (open), two-row necklace.
Primary event: wide shot facing an orange-red sunset, hair and dress moving in the wind.
End state: full silhouette against the sunset, a warm rim-light outlining both necklace chains.

[Stage 10 — 27-29s: Balcony Close]
Use: pendant necklace (open, watch face visible).
Primary event: on a warm-lit balcony at dusk, she turns into an intimate close-up, softly smiling, glancing briefly down at the open watch face.
End state: her face and the open pendant both in sharp, warm-lit focus.

[Stage 11 — 29-30s: End Plate]
Primary event: gentle push-out and defocus as she exits frame, leaving a clean, evenly lit, warm terracotta-toned empty background with soft bokeh.
End state: uncluttered negative space, ready for the Van Cleef & Arpels logo to be composited in post. ko.content:
---
[생성 목표]
Van Cleef & Arpels 파인 주얼리를 위한 30초 분량의 시네마틱 라이프스타일 필름을 생성한다. 중심 인물은 따뜻한 해안 마을에서 골든 아워의 하루를 보내는 20세 동아시아 여성이다. 주요 이벤트는 그녀가 Van Cleef & Arpels Alhambra 스타일의 카넬리언과 로즈골드 주얼리 컬렉션 — 비밀 시계를 드러내도록 열리는 펜던트 네크리스, 투-로 레이어드 네크리스, 드롭 이어링, 두 개의 브레이슬릿(그중 하나는 시계 페이스를 숨기고 있음), 그리고 링 — 을 착용하고 상호작용하는 장면이며, 그중 한 장면은 그녀가 직접 펜던트의 비밀 시계를 여는 장면으로 구성한다.

[참조 자료]
@ Image 1은 핏/스케일만 정의한다 — 네크리스가 네크라인과 쇄골에 어떻게 걸리는지. 이 인물의 얼굴, 몸, 정체성은 사용하지 말 것.
@ Image 2는 싱글 드롭 이어링의 구조, 메탈 색상, 클로버 참 디자인을 정의한다.
@ Image 3는 페어 드롭 이어링의 구조와 매달리고 움직이는 방식을 정의한다.
@ Image 4는 투-로 레이어드 네크리스를 정의한다 — 로즈골드와 카넬리언 클로버의 교차 배열, 체인 간격, 드레이프.
@ Image 5는 핏/스케일만 정의한다 — 펜던트가 쇄골 근처에 어떻게 놓이는지. 이 인물의 얼굴, 몸, 정체성은 사용하지 말 것.
@ Image 6은 댕글 체인 브레이슬릿의 구조를 정의한다 — 카넬리언 클로버 참이 달린 체인.
@ Image 7은 라운드 브레이슬릿의 구조를 정의한다 — 로즈골드와 카넬리언 클로버가 교차하는 완전한 원형.
@ Image 8은 핏/스케일만 정의한다 — 펜던트가 어떻게 잡히고 몸에 기대어 놓이는지. 이 인물의 얼굴, 몸, 정체성은 사용하지 말 것.
@ Image 9는 펜던트 네크리스의 체인 길이, 클라스프, 그리고 펜던트가 매달리는 방식을 정의한다.
@ Image 10은 체인과 분리된 상태에서 카넬리언 클로버 커버의 정확한 형태, 베젤 디테일, 색상을 정의한다.
@ Image 11은 링의 구조와 메탈/스톤 마감을 정의한다. [이것이 링인지 확인해 주세요 — 스크린샷에서 썸네일이 잘려 있었습니다.]
@ Video 1은 동작만 정의한다: 손가락이 힌지 달린 카넬리언 클로버 커버를 들어 올려 아래의 마더오브펄 시계 페이스를 드러내는 장면이며, 커버의 피벗 포인트는 상단 가장자리에 있다. 이 비디오의 인물, 의상, 배경은 사용하지 말 것.

[Subject Profile: The Woman]
20세 동아시아 여성, 다이아몬드형 얼굴, 아담한 체형, 또렷한 턱선, 따뜻한 자연스러운 미소, 어두운 머리카락, 내추럴 메이크업, 캠페인 모델처럼 글래머러스하게 스타일링되었지만 포즈를 취한 듯하지 않고 자연스럽게 움직이고 반응한다. 얼굴, 헤어스타일, 비율, 의상은 모든 단계에서 동일하게 유지된다. 소개된 이후에는 모든 주얼리를 동시에, 일관되게 착용한다: 투-로 네크리스 위에 펜던트 네크리스, 드롭 이어링, 한쪽 손목의 라운드 브레이슬릿, 다른 쪽 손목의 댕글 브레이슬릿, 그리고 링 — Stage 3에서 펜던트 커버가 한 번 열리는 것 외에는 필름 중간에 아무것도 추가되거나 제거되지 않는다.

[Stage 1 — 0-3s: Street Walk]
@ Imagewo-row layered necklace (@ Image 4), fit reference @  Image 1.
Initial state: 따뜻한 테라코타 톤의 해안가 거리, 낮은 골든 선라이트.
Primary event: 그녀가 따뜻한 톤의 리조트웨어를 입고 카메라를 향해 걸어오며, 투-로 네크리스가 걸음마다 쇄골 위에서 빛을 받는다.
End state: 바람에 흩날리는 가까운 프레이밍이 그녀의 얼굴과 네크라인에 안정적으로 머문다.

[Stage 2 — 3-6s: Pendant Close-Up]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), fit reference @ Image 8.
Primary event: 카메라가 그녀의 미소 짓는 얼굴에서 아래로 틸트되어, 투-로 네크리스 위에 놓인 닫힌 카넬리언 펜던트로 내려간다; 그녀의 손가락이 펜던트를 가볍게 들어 올려 살펴본다.
End state: 펜던트가 중앙에 선명하게 잡히고, 얕은 심도 속에서 여전히 닫힌 상태로 유지된다.

[Stage 3 — 6-9s: The Reveal]
Use: pendant necklace (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), reveal motion (@ Video 1).
Primary event: 매크로 샷으로, 그녀가 두 손가락으로 힌지 달린 카넬리언 클로버 커버를 부드럽게 열어 마더오브펄 시계 다이얼과 그 아래의 골드 핸즈를 드러낸다. 이 동작과 피벗 포인트는 @ Video 1과 정확히 일치해야 한다.
End state: 펜던트가 열린 상태가 되고, 시계 페이스가 완전히 보이며 빛을 받고, 커버는 체인에 기대어 세워진다.

[Stage 4 — 9-12s: Warm Courtyard Walk]
Use: round bracelet (@ Image 7).
Primary event: 햇빛이 드는 테라코타 포장 바닥을 따라 로우 앵글 트래킹 샷으로 그녀가 걷는다; 라운드 브레이슬릿이 걸음마다 손목에서 빛을 받는다.
End state: 브레이슬릿이 전경에서 선명하고 밝게 보이며, 그녀의 실루엣은 프레임 밖으로 계속 나간다.

[Stage 5 — 12-15s: Terrace Profile]
Use: drop earrings (@ Image 2, @ Image 3).
Primary event: 골든 아워의 따뜻한 루프탑 테라스에서 그녀가 옆모습으로 서 있고, 바람이 머리카락을 움직인다; 드롭 이어링이 부드럽게 흔들리며 빛을 받는다.
End state: 따뜻한 하늘을 배경으로 깨끗한 옆모습 실루엣이 잡히고, 이어링은 흔들리는 중간 순간에 빛난다.

[Stage 6 — 15-18s: Café]
Use: dangle bracelet (@ Image 6), ring (@ Image 11).
Primary event: 햇빛이 드는 창가 테이블에 앉아 그녀가 음료를 입가로 들어 올린다; 손이 움직일 때 댕글 브레이슬릿과 링이 모두 따뜻한 빛을 받는다.
End state: 브레이슬릿과 링이 전경에서 선명하고, 뒤의 카페 내부는 부드럽게 흐려진다.

[Stage 7 — 18-21s: Warm Water]
Use: pendant necklace (open, from Stage 3), two-row necklace (@ Image 4).
Primary event: 따뜻한 앰버 톤의 얕은 물에서 수면 높이 시점으로 촬영하며, 그녀가 물에 떠 웃는다; 물방울이 열린 펜던트와 레이어드 네크리스 위에서 빛을 받는다.
End state: 그녀가 웃음의 중간에서 잠시 멈추고, 두 네크리스가 물방울 사이로 반짝인다.

[Stage 8 — 21-24s: Night Market]
Use: drop earrings, round bracelet.
Primary event: 랜턴 불빛이 가득한 마켓을 핸드헬드로 걸어간다; 그녀가 간식을 집으려 손을 뻗는 순간, 손목과 이어링이 따뜻한 랜턴 빛과 네온 빛을 함께 받는다.
End state: 손이 뻗어진 채 멈춘 순간, 주얼리가 흐릿한 마켓 보

pt.content:
---
[Objetivo de Geração]
Gerar um filme lifestyle cinematográfico de 30 segundos para joias finas Van Cleef & Arpels. O sujeito central é uma mulher leste-asiática de 20 anos vivendo um dia em golden hour em uma cidade litorânea de clima quente. O evento principal é ela usando e interagindo com uma coleção de joias Van Cleef & Arpels estilo Alhambra em cornalina e ouro rosé — um colar com pingente que se abre para revelar um relógio escondido, um colar em camadas de duas fileiras, brincos pendentes, duas pulseiras (uma também ocultando um mostrador de relógio) e um anel — com uma cena construída em torno dela abrindo pessoalmente o relógio secreto do pingente.

[Materiais de Referência]
@ Image 1 define apenas caimento/escala — como um colar se posiciona sobre o decote e a clavícula. Não use o rosto, o corpo ou a identidade dessa pessoa.
@ Image 2 define a estrutura do brinco pendente único, a cor do metal e o design do pingente em trevo.
@ Image 3 define a estrutura dos brincos pendentes em par e como eles se movem e balançam.
@ Image 4 define o colar em camadas de duas fileiras — trevos alternados em ouro rosé e cornalina, espaçamento da corrente e caimento.
@ Image 5 define apenas caimento/escala — como o pingente fica próximo à clavícula. Não use o rosto, o corpo ou a identidade dessa pessoa.
@ Image 6 define a estrutura da pulseira com corrente pendente — corrente com pingentes de trevo em cornalina.
@ Image 7 define a estrutura da pulseira redonda — círculo completo de trevos alternados em ouro rosé e cornalina.
@ Image 8 define apenas caimento/escala — como o pingente é segurado e repousa contra o corpo. Não use o rosto, o corpo ou a identidade dessa pessoa.
@ Image 9 define o comprimento da corrente do colar com pingente, o fecho e como o pingente fica pendurado.
@ Image 10 define a forma exata da cobertura em trevo de cornalina, o detalhe da moldura e a cor, isolada da corrente.
@ Image 11 define a estrutura do anel e o acabamento em metal/pedra. [Por favor, confirme se este é o anel — a miniatura foi cortada na sua captura de tela.]
@ Video 1 define apenas o movimento: dedos levantando a cobertura articulada em trevo de cornalina para revelar o mostrador do relógio em madrepérola por baixo, com o ponto de pivô da cobertura na borda superior. Não use a pessoa, a roupa ou o fundo deste vídeo.

[Perfil do Sujeito: A Mulher]
Mulher leste-asiática de 20 anos, rosto em formato de diamante, porte pequeno, mandíbula marcada, sorriso natural e caloroso, cabelo escuro, maquiagem natural, estilizada de forma glamourosa como uma modelo de campanha, mas se movendo e reagindo de maneira natural, e não posada. Seu rosto, penteado, proporções e roupa permanecem idênticos em todas as etapas. Ela usa todas as peças simultaneamente e de forma consistente assim que introduzidas: o colar com pingente sobre o colar de duas fileiras, os brincos pendentes, a pulseira redonda em um pulso, a pulseira com corrente pendente no outro e o anel — nada é adicionado ou removido no meio do filme, exceto a cobertura do pingente, que se abre uma vez na Etapa 3 e permanece aberta pelo restante do filme.

[Etapa 1 — 0-3s: Caminhada na Rua]
@ Imagewo-row layered necklace (@ Image 4), fit reference @  Image 1.
Estado inicial: rua costeira em tons quentes de terracota, luz baixa de golden hour.
Evento principal: ela caminha em direção à câmera usando uma roupa resort fluida em tons quentes; o colar de duas fileiras capta a luz na clavícula a cada passo.
Estado final: enquadramento próximo, com vento, se estabilizando em seu rosto e decote.

[Etapa 2 — 3-6s: Close-up do Pingente]
Use: colar com pingente (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), referência de caimento @ Image 8.
Evento principal: a câmera inclina para baixo do rosto sorridente até o pingente de cornalina fechado repousando sobre o colar de duas fileiras; seus dedos levantam levemente o pingente para examiná-lo.
Estado final: pingente centralizado e nítido em foco raso, ainda fechado.

[Etapa 3 — 6-9s: A Revelação]
Use: colar com pingente (@ Image 9, @ Image 10), movimento de revelação (@ Video 1).
Evento principal: plano macro enquanto ela abre suavemente a cobertura articulada em trevo de cornalina com dois dedos, revelando o mostrador do relógio em madrepérola e os ponteiros dourados por baixo, exatamente correspondendo ao movimento de abertura e ao ponto de pivô de @ Video 1.
Estado final: pingente agora aberto, mostrador totalmente visível e iluminado, cobertura apoiada na vertical contra a corrente.

[Etapa 4 — 9-12s: Caminhada no Pátio Quente]
Use: pulseira redonda (@ Image 7).
Evento principal: plano de acompanhamento em ângulo baixo ao longo de um piso de terracota iluminado pelo sol enquanto ela caminha; a pulseira redonda capta a luz no pulso a cada passo.
Estado final: pulseira nítida e iluminada em primeiro plano, sua figura continuando para fora do quadro.

[Etapa 5 — 12-15s: Perfil no Terraço]
Use: brincos pendentes (@ Image 2, @ Image 3).
Evento principal: ela está em perfil em um terraço de cobertura quente durante a golden hour, com o vento movendo o cabelo; os brincos pendentes balançam suavemente e captam a luz.
Estado final: silhueta de perfil limpa contra o céu quente, brincos em meio ao balanço e iluminados.

[Etapa 6 — 15-18s: Café]
Use: pulseira com corrente pendente (@ Image 6), anel (@ Image 11).
Evento principal: sentada à mesa ao lado de uma janela ensolarada, ela ergue uma bebida em direção aos lábios; a pulseira com corrente pendente e o anel captam a luz quente enquanto a mão se move.
Estado final: pulseira e anel nítidos em primeiro plano, interior do café suave ao fundo.

[Etapa 7 — 18-21s: Água Quente]
Use: colar com pingente (aberto, da Etapa 3), colar de duas fileiras (@ Image 4).
Evento principal: plano ao nível da água em águas rasas iluminadas por um tom âmbar enquanto ela flutua e ri; gotas captam a luz no pingente aberto e no colar em camadas.
Estado final: ela se acomoda no meio do riso, ambos os colares brilhando através das gotas de água.

[Etapa 8 — 21-24s: Mercado Noturno]
Use: brincos pendentes, pulseira redonda.
Evento principal: caminhada com câmera na mão por um mercado iluminado por lanternas; ela alcança um doce, com o pulso e os brincos captando a luz quente das lanternas e dos néons.
Estado final: sua mão no meio do alcance, joias brilhando suavemente contra o bokeh desfocado do mercado.

[Etapa 9 — 24-27s: Silhueta ao Pôr do Sol]

为 Van Cleef & Arpels 高级珠宝生成一支 30 秒的 cinematic lifestyle film。核心主体是一位 20 岁的东亚女性，生活在一个温暖海滨小镇的 golden-hour 时段。主要事件是她佩戴并与一套 Van Cleef & Arpels Alhambra 风格的红玉髓与玫瑰金珠宝系列互动——包括一条可打开并露出隐藏腕表的吊坠项链、一条双层项链、垂坠耳环、两条手链（其中一条也隐藏表盘）以及一枚戒指——其中有一个场景围绕她亲手打开吊坠中的秘密腕表展开。
